name: Cream and Dream
source:
You secretly yearn for Yutaka Himeji, the boy one year ahead at school. 
When October comes you meet a guy named Amane who says he has magic powers. 
He says if you give him (Amane) sweets every day, he'll make Himeji-senpai like you but, 
you feel like you're just being used by Amane. 
Then you start to feel like you're attracted to him... 

[From DLsite English]
No longer available.
